body: Fractal lattice of porous silicates; pores open with thermal expansion

skill.effect: The creature opens its pores to filter the air and absorb nutrients, releasing a shimmering zone of thin air that strongly slows nearby enemies.

journal.en: A living sieve that waits for the sky to warm, then drinks the thin air.

plausibility.summary: Describe Sifon-Hielo as anchored silicate frustum with organosilicon filter biofilm; cite F10 aerosol load and F15 slow diffusion as the real selective root, not azotosomes for the whole body.

skill.effect: Absorbs heat from a target; target takes thermal damage and Sifon-Hielo heals.

chains.weakness: Vulnerable to freezing attacks that close pores.

journal.en: Its pores flare open like a thousand tiny lungs gasping for warmth.

plausibility.summary: Specify bilayer hinges: quartz/silicate pore rim + organosilicon flap that unseals at ~110–120 K; avoid implying the entire lattice is a flexible siloxane polymer.

skill.effect: The creature anchors itself firmly to the ground with crystalline roots, becoming completely stationary and firmly resisting any force that tries to move it.

journal.en: Roots of crystal grip the ridge, defying the gale.

plausibility.summary: Immobile filter feeders on wind-swept cryo plateaus must anchor against dense-air gusts (F9, F10); lower gravity reduces anchorage stress (F4). Growth of ice-penetrating crystal roots is consistent with silicate biomineralization and frost wedging in ridge substrates — standard trade-off: +defence, zero relocation.

skill.effect: The creature emits a resonant warning hum that alerts nearby allies, allowing them to react swiftly to incoming threats.

journal.en: It sings the world's heartbeat to prepare for the thaw.

plausibility.summary: Sound speed ~260 m/s and high atmospheric density (F9) give long infrasonic range — a lattice with resonant void geometry can couple to distant pulse precursors (jet bangs, tidal flexure groans F6, rare flare-ionization transients F3). Sharing pulse timing with allies is adaptive for synchronizing bloom with Vivisilice-style predators also cueing on heat/sound. Cost: resonance advertises a warm-opening sieve to IR/infrasonic hunters (F18).
